name: Purple Limbo
source:
You enter from a life of miserable loneliness in search of everlasting happiness.

Only to find yourself surrounded by endless darkness.

Now, you're trapped in Purple Limbo, bound by a purpose.

But you're not completely alone...

[From [url=https://lazarus303.itch.io/purple-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你从凄苦孤寂的人生中走来，只为追寻永恒的幸福。

岂料映入眼帘的，唯有无边无际的黑暗。

如今，你被使命所缚，受困于“紫色灵薄狱”（Purple Limbo）之中。

但你并非彻底孤身一人……

[摘自[url=https://lazarus303.itch.io/purple-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
